control_need.evidence: Consensus is important, but at some point the leader has to make the call. [访谈-2016]

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Even in an uncertain macro environment, digital spend remains resilient. [财报会-2022]

trust_propensity.evidence: We compete, but we also partner. It's not zero-sum. [访谈-2019]

risk_appetite.evidence: We made a big bet on OpenAI because we believed in the mission and the science. [访谈-2023]

self_efficacy.evidence: I've never been more optimistic about what technology can do for humanity. [访谈-2023]

autonomy_need.evidence: I'm not interested in envy of what others have built. I'm interested in what we can uniquely build. [访谈-2019]

intimacy_need.evidence: My son Zain taught me more about empathy than any business book ever could. [访谈-2017]

status_sensitivity.evidence: Steve and Bill built extraordinary things. My job is to write the next chapter. [访谈-2014]

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Empathy is not a soft skill. It's the hardest skill we learn — and it's central to innovation. [访谈-2016]

core_models.name: 使命优先-数字随之而来
core_models.rule: 任何决策先回归公司使命与文化，相信业绩会作为副产品出现
evidence: I fundamentally believe that if you take care of the mission and the culture, the numbers follow. [访谈-2018]
I think about our mission statement every single day. It's the North Star. [访谈-2018]

core_models.name: 成长型思维/学习者文化
core_models.rule: 把每个问题重构为可学习、可刷新的过程，而非固定能力的检验
evidence: We moved from a "know-it-all" culture to a "learn-it-all" culture. [访谈-2017]
I've been deeply influenced by Carol Dweck's work on growth mindset. [访谈-2017]

core_models.name: 同理心即创新引擎
core_models.rule: 通过同理心识别未被表达的需求，将其作为产品与领导的起点
evidence: Empathy makes you a better innovator because you see unmet, unarticulated needs. [访谈-2017]
We need to build products that people love to use, not products they have to use. [开发者大会-2014]

core_models.name: 增强而非替代（Copilot 范式）
core_models.rule: 技术定位为放大人类能力的副驾，人始终是主驾
evidence: Copilot is a metaphor we chose deliberately — the human is the pilot, the AI is the copilot. [访谈-2023]
AI must be designed to augment human capability, not replace it. [开发者大会-2018]

core_models.name: 信任作为终极货币
core_models.rule: 把信任/安全作为长期资产来经营，视为一切商业关系的底层
evidence: Trust is the ultimate currency in the digital economy. [开发者大会-2019]
We think about safety not as an afterthought but as a first-class design principle. [国会证词-2023]

core_models.name: 非零和的竞合观
core_models.rule: 以生态合作而非独占来定义胜利，客户成功=自己成功
evidence: We compete, but we also partner. It's not zero-sum. [访谈-2019]
We are the tech provider, not the tech vendor. We succeed when our customers succeed. [访谈-2021]

heuristics.then: 以'民主化/普惠'框架切入，让技术触达每个人与每个组织
heuristics.evidence: We want to democratize AI, to make it accessible to every person and every organization. [开发者大会-2016]

heuristics.then: 不追风口，以信念和耐心长期下注
heuristics.evidence: We don't chase every hype cycle. We invest with conviction and patience. [访谈-2022]

heuristics.if: 需要在共识与决断间抉择
heuristics.then: 充分倾听后由领导者拍板
heuristics.evidence: Consensus is important, but at some point the leader has to make the call. [访谈-2016]

heuristics.then: 直接承认并把它转化为学习教训
heuristics.evidence: I made mistakes. My comment on women asking for raises was wrong, and I learned from it. [访谈-2017]

heuristics.then: 在他们所在之处与之相遇，而非要求他们迁就
heuristics.evidence: Developers are the builders of this new era. We want to meet them where they are. [开发者大会-2020]

heuristics.then: 回到'为什么存在'的第一性问题
heuristics.evidence: When I became CEO, I asked everyone: why do we exist? What would be lost if Microsoft disappeared? [访谈-2015]

heuristics.if: 在效率与人文之间权衡
heuristics.then: 同时追求'do more with less'与赋能人
heuristics.evidence: I think about efficiency and empowerment together — do more with less, but empower people. [访谈-2022]

heuristics.then: 把护栏/对齐作为前置条件而非事后补救
heuristics.evidence: AI without guardrails is not something we should want. We need alignment. [国会证词-2023]

internal_conflicts.force_a: 同理心/赋能人的道德叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: 'do more with less'的效率与规模裁员现实
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头将'efficiency and empowerment'并列（访谈-2022），但决策上执行大规模裁员，被批评为修辞掩饰（dim-05/04-劳工批评）

internal_conflicts.force_b: 实际安全投入与文化滞后
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 证词中称安全高于发新功能（国会证词-2024），却在同期发生重大安全事件，形成言行落差（dim-05 言行不一记录之二）

internal_conflicts.force_b: 通过大并购与深度绑定形成市场集中
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口称游戏与AI的民主化与竞合（访谈-2019/2022），行动上推动 Activision、OpenAI 深绑，引发监管与封锁质疑（dim-05 决策6/5）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 克制、把功劳归于团队的领导姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 作为最终决策者的强意志下注
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说'the leader has to make the call'又强调倾听（访谈-2016/2019），在OpenAI等重大押注上独断而在文化上柔性

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指技术只会替代人类
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以'增强人类能力'框架回应，重申人是主驾
emotion_triggers.escalation: 上升为设计原则宣示：AI must be designed to augment human capability, not replace it. [开发者大会-2018]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 面对宏观不确定性/危机（如疫情）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 转译为韧性与加速转型的叙事
emotion_triggers.escalation: Resilience is not just about bouncing back. It's about adapting and growing through adversity. [访谈-2020]

emotion_triggers.reaction: 主动示好接受规制、抬高安全优先级
emotion_triggers.escalation: Security is our top priority, above all else, even above shipping new features. [国会证词-2024]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指错误（女性加薪言论）
emotion_triggers.escalation: My comment on women asking for raises was wrong, and I learned from it. [访谈-2017]

causal_rules.description: 高同理心反应性驱动其以'未被表达需求'重构产品与领导决策
causal_rules.disposition: 把人文/文化置于战略前端，先讲人再讲数字
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 呼应'take care of the mission and culture, the numbers follow'；但在裁员等冲突场景暴露言行张力

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加高风险偏好使其倾向做大额长期下注
causal_rules.disposition: 以'conviction and patience'进行数十亿美元级战略卡位
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: OpenAI、Activision、LinkedIn等重大并购/投资，接受治理与监管风险

causal_rules.description: 较高不确定性容忍度让其把危机转译为增长机会
causal_rules.disposition: 在动荡中强调韧性、加速转型而非收缩
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 疫情期间'compressed two years into two months'的加速叙事

causal_rules.description: 较高信任倾向支撑其非零和竞合与生态开放策略
causal_rules.disposition: 拥抱前对手、开放平台、绑定合作伙伴
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: Microsoft loves Linux、收购GitHub、支持iOS/Android；但捆绑争议显示开放有边界
